notes: Crawford Road is printed CRAWFORD at the top and ROAD near y 5200; a heavy line (track) runs along it and a parallel outer line east of it north of y 2250 is a boundary, not a street; centre taken midway between the west block line and the east road line. Dane Street: name printed at about (8815, 2970), ST. at (9120, 5830); centre taken midway between block/lot lines (an inner line runs about 20-35 px inside the east side). The street called Apjones Street here is printed APJONES west of Dane (about x 7900, y 4250) and only ST. with 60 east of Dane; assumed the same street. Two avenues meeting Dane Street print only AVENUE near the strip (at about (8540, 3650) and (8700, 5140)); their names were not found within about 2000 px west, so they are '?'. The lower one continues east of Dane unnamed (6 in. W. pipe) and dead-ends at the railroad. The '?' at Crawford Road y 3533 is an unnamed 30 ft strip between the Stella Darragh and Herman Kist tracts, possibly a private lane. Dicks Alley is a named alley between Apjones and Ellis Streets. Dane Street / the street at y 3140 (ST., 60 ft) lies at about x 8800, outside the margin, not picked. Railroads (B&O, spur curve into the R. L. Greeno Co.) and dashed sewers ignored.
